module.purpose: Provides a server-rendered route layout that restricts organization settings pages to organization administrators or owners.
module.summary: This Next.js layout obtains the current server session from request headers and cookies, determines the user's organization role with a membership fallback, and permits rendering only for administrators or owners. Unauthorized users are redirected to the organization profile settings page.
module.businessContext: Supports access control for organization administration settings. If it fails, unauthorized users may access administrative pages or legitimate administrators may be blocked.
functions: OrgAdminOnlyLayout (~L9-23): Authorizes organization administrators before rendering nested settings content

preconditions: The input contains a children value compatible with React.ReactNode.
Server request context is available through headers and cookies.
postconditions: If the resolved organization role is administrative or owner-level, returns the supplied children unchanged.
If the user is not an organization administrator or owner, initiates a redirect to /settings/organizations/profile.
invariants: Access is granted only when checkAdminOrOwner returns true for the resolved organization role.
The session organization role takes precedence over the matching profile organization membership role.
edgeCases: When no session, user, organization role, or matching profile membership exists, access is denied and the user is redirected.
When the session organization role is absent, the role of the profile organization member whose userId matches the session user id is used as a fallback.
When the profile organization has no matching member, the resolved role remains undefined and access is denied.
